msg: warning: Variable k_crcs is a dead store!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 5275b1e49f6.c (BusyBox insmod). Dead store on 'k_crcs' at line 25 ('k_crcs = someInt'), presence condition True. When VERSION_CHECKING=true: k_crcs=someInt is assigned but never read afterward (simplification artifact). When VERSION_CHECKING=false: k_crcs is undeclared — the tool should report UndeclaredIdentifier but instead treats it as 0 and reports a dead store. In both configurations the dead store alarm is a false positive. The known vbdb bug (UndeclaredIdentifier on k_crcs when VERSION_CHECKING=false) is not correctly detected.
